purpose: Interface contract between Benji's off-chain strategy controller (policy brain) and Bob's on-chain keeper (execution). Controller emits INTENTs; keeper executes on Base and returns FILL_REPORTs + periodic POSITION_STATE. v1.1 aligns to Bob's execution verbs + Slipstream.

venue.primary: Aerodrome Slipstream (Base-native CL) — gauged pools pay AERO emissions on the parked position while it waits for the range to fill: free yield subsidizing the buyback during dead time.
venue.fallback: Uniswap V3 on Base via a config flag (NonfungiblePositionManager-style iface) — keeper handles the mapping; controller layer unchanged.
venue.tick_spacing: per-pool (Slipstream), e.g. 1 / 50 / 100 / 200. Controller sends clean price bounds; keeper snaps per `snap` policy. Optional explicit ticks supported.

rung_types.buy: single-sided USDC BELOW spot; converts USDC→token as price falls. Sized P_bot=(Q/T)^2/P_top; avg fill = geomean of bounds.
rung_types.sell: single-sided TOKEN ABOVE spot; converts token→USDC as price rises. The exit side.

intent.intent_id: string · IDEMPOTENCY key — keeper dedupes; a retried intent_id never double-executes
intent.nonce: int · monotonic per-controller sequence — orders intents, guards against races/reordering
intent.action: "mint" | "burn" | "rerange" | "collect"  (rerange = burn ref + mint new bounds, atomic if pool allows; collect = harvest fees + AERO)
intent.P_top: number · upper price bound USDC/token (clean; keeper snaps)
intent.tick_lower: int · OPTIONAL explicit tick (if controller pre-snaps); overrides P_bot when present
intent.tick_upper: int · OPTIONAL explicit tick; overrides P_top when present
intent.snap: "nearest" | "inward" | "outward"  · rounding direction when snapping prices→ticks (single-sided wants the range kept on the correct side of spot; default inward)

amount.value: number · USDC for buy rung, tokens for sell rung

intent.ref_position_id: string · required for burn / rerange / collect — the tokenId to act on

position_state._dir: keeper → controller · event-driven or periodic; powers roll decisions + monitoring UI

rung_lifecycle: PLANNED → OPEN(mint) → CONVERTING → FILLED → { ROLLED(rerange) | HELD | CLOSED(burn) }
CANCELLED — controller burns an OPEN/CONVERTING rung early (re-range on spot drift)
collect — fee/AERO harvest, any time, non-destructive
FAILED — tx/keeper error; controller retries (same intent_id) or alerts
notes: Idempotency: keeper dedupes on intent_id; nonce enforces ordering. Retries are safe, never double-mint.

Controller holds NO keys — Bob's keeper owns a DEDICATED, isolated LP signer/wallet (never the custodial tunnel hot wallet). New key, new systemd unit, forked from the proven bridge-daemon supervision.

PnL/accounting reconstructed purely from fill_reports + position_state (usdc/token in-out + fees + AERO rewards + gas). AERO emissions now flow into realized/unrealized yield — the Slipstream subsidy is tracked, not ignored.
Bounds stay venue-neutral; venue flag + tick_spacing come from `pool`.
